amountTooltip: Order quantity at this price, in {{coin}}
totalTooltip: Cumulative quantity up to this price, in {{coin}}
leverageRiskShort: Leverage amplifies gains and losses. Trade with caution.
marginTip: Margin is the funds locked to open this position. Margin = order value ÷ leverage.
leverageTip: Leverage multiplies your buying power and risk. Higher leverage means a smaller price move can liquidate you.
marginModeTip: Isolated uses each position's own margin; Cross backs the position with your whole available balance.
liqPriceTip: If the price reaches this level, your position may be force-closed (liquidated).
confirmOrderRisk: Leverage amplifies both profit and loss — you could lose your entire margin. Please confirm.
amountBelowMinimum: Amount is less than the minimum bet for the selected period
notionalExceeded: Order value exceeds the max of {{max}} {{asset}}

optionActiveOrderSettling: Your order is settling. Please wait a moment.
settlementRateUnavailable: Settlement rate for this market is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
netProfitTooltip: Net profit = gross realized PnL − trading fees. Funding fees are not included.
optionExpectedReturnFeeNote: Net of the fee — the profit you receive if the trade wins.
leverageRisk: When trading with leverage over 10x, positions can only withstand small price fluctuations. Please be aware of the risks. Leverage adjustments will apply to both positions and orders.
payoutRateTooltip: Return rate is your net profit on top of the stake when the trade wins. For example, a return rate of 15% earns an extra 15 {{asset}} on a 100 {{asset}} stake — 15 {{asset}} profit, 115 {{asset}} returned in total.
